mov: Radical republicanism of the Jacobin Club, which led the Revolution's most radical phase and the Terror (1793-1794).
periods.glance: French First Republic, 1792 to 1794: parliamentary republic. About 29 million people in 1792 (estimate). Leaders: Georges Danton, Maximilien Robespierre, Jacques-Louis David and others. Movements: French Revolution and Jacobinism.
